dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped circular and semi-circular light-intensity rings (annuli) exhibit soft-edged gradient transitions from high-intensity perimeters to low-intensity interiors. Notable structures include a well-defined 'O' annulus in the lower-central region and several overlapping 'C' and 'O' shaped structures along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. A single, high-intensity, solid light-colored circular pixel cluster lacking an internal gradient is clearly visible in the upper right quadrant, situated between two larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The primary geometric relationship is defined by an obtuse triangle formed by connecting the centroid of the prominent lower-central annulus, the centroid of the upper-mid annulus, and the centroid of the high-intensity circular blob in the upper right.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, high-contrast yellow linear feature, likely a blade of dry vegetation, originates from the lower right perimeter and extends diagonally into the center-right region, occluding the underlying texture.
